# openinfra_identity_provider (Resource)

An external OIDC identity provider the platform trusts for sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity — the AWS "Identity providers" registry. Register an issuer + audiences; a Role whose trust names `OIDC::<name>` may then be assumed by that issuer's tokens. The counterpart to `kind: UserPool` (which issues tokens); register a UserPool's issuer here to close the loop. OIDC only (SAML deferred).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `audiences` (List of String) Accepted token audiences (the `aud` claim / client IDs). A token is trusted only if its aud is listed; unaudienced tokens are refused.
- `issuer_url` (String) The OIDC issuer URL (the token's `iss` claim); its discovery document + JWKS verify token signatures.
- `name` (String) Resource name. Changing it replaces the resource.

### Optional

- `namespace` (String) Kubernetes namespace. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `subject_claim` (String) The token claim used as the assumed subject (and matched by a role's trust policy). Defaults to `sub`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `namespace/name`, the import identifier.
- `ready` (Boolean) Whether the resource's Ready condition is True. Terraform returns as soon as the object is accepted, so this is usually `false` immediately after apply — the platform reconciles asynchronously.
